title: Make recovery exit status and runtime-directory preparation classification discoverable
outcome: Deploy checks can identify the two additional recovery contracts, or their documented fix classification is explicit.
acceptance: The recovered-shim exit-status contract and preparation-time runtime-directory refusal each have an appropriate singular features[] ID, or their fix-only treatment is explicitly resolved against the standing feature-ID directive; normal/unavailable manifest assertions preserve the existing 2 KiB reserve and all existing claims without changing limits.

completion.summary: Explicitly classified runtime preparation, retirement authority, recovered-shim exit and cancellation invalidation as repairs of existing contracts covered by v0.12.108, after independent consultation; manifest IDs and unchanged reserve validated. Reviewer Low retained.
